execution_surface: Codex CLI ephemeral isolated sessions under owner ChatGPT sign-in; no API key or separately billed provider API
runtime_preflight: Owner authorization must cover a read-only CLI version/help probe and the bounded CLI execution; the prior exec --help attempt was rejected by automatic approval review and was not executed.
activation_gate: Verify actual ChatGPT authentication mode without printing credentials; reject API-key mode. Record observed model/effort, actual tool isolation and source/context digests for each run. Missing or mismatched runtime evidence keeps no-go; never silently fall back.

cost_policy.billing: No separately billed API calls; consume only existing Codex allowance
cost_policy.quota_exhaustion: stop; no fallback provider or model
cost_policy.unknown_cost: no_go; do not claim cost improvement or waive comparison silently

reviewer_policy: Start no reviewer calls until all 12 pairs pass schema, patch-bound deterministic checks and freeze verification. Separate independent sessions, random opaque candidate IDs, no arm labels or self-scores; unresolved critical/high finding blocks promotion.
retention: Synthetic source/patches/check receipts only in ignored workspace run directory. Retain sanitized aggregate, hashes, latency/token/cost availability and reviewer findings in owning specs. No private chats, secrets, user data or authentication material.
stop_conditions: first invalid output or deterministic failure
single_use: Mark consumed before first call; approval cannot be reused after any call starts. A resumed run needs a new exact approval.
rollback: Stop further calls, preserve sanitized failure evidence; discard only disposable candidate changes after review. Canonical product sources, cache and trust are not mutated by T34.
decision: no_go until actual valid pair/reviewer/usage evidence exists; no guaranteed promotion

owner_decision.scope: All three previously prepared packets, unchanged bounds; pilot results must be returned for owner acceptance
owner_decision.source: Current user continuation in owning G6 chat
